summary: Verified the MyDezider MPPS → Step-10 Action Plan auto-push feature end-to-end. Backend bracketed title format is EXACTLY as specified (`[Factor Name - <projected%>] · <action/improvement_plan> · [+<delta>%]`). Idempotency on stable mpps_key works (2nd call → 0). Self-heal updates an existing item's title when projected % changes. Explicit delta_percentage takes priority over original/projected diff. Delta=0 correctly omits the `[+0%]` block. Frontend Step 10 auto-loads the imported items via useEffect without any user click, and a page reload does NOT create duplicates (API list length remained 2). 5 new pytest tests (test_iter44_mpps_to_action_plan.py) all pass; full action-items regression suite passes (25/25 after a minor test-string update for the new format). Live curl against the user's sample data produced VERBATIM the expected strings: `[Salary & Compensation - 90] · Negotiate salary increase after 6 months + annual bonus structure · [+20%]` and `[Career Growth Opportunities - 85] · Request mentorship program, lead client project, and attend industry conferences · [+25%]`.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/action_items.py: import-from-mpps endpoint does NOT validate that the requesting user owns the decision via org context; it relies only on `user_id` match in db.decisions.find_one. That is correct for personal MyDezider data but may need revisiting if shared/org decisions ever flow through MPPS.

Step10.tsx: import POST is fire-and-forget — even on auth failure (e.g. expired token) it silently swallows the error and still flips mppsReady to true. Consider surfacing a toast on non-2xx so silent failures don't leave Step 10 looking empty.
Step10.tsx is 345 lines — acceptable; no split needed.

ActionItemEditor.tsx properly uses View/Text/TouchableOpacity, no HTML primitives, StyleSheet.create used. No deprecated expo-av/expo-barcode-scanner/expo-background-fetch usage found in the touched files.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_action_items.py (legacy assertion updated for new bracketed title format — substring match instead of exact)

rca_of_issue: N/A — feature works correctly. Earlier iteration's bug (titles missing rating + delta) is fixed by the new helpers _realistic_rating/_fmt_delta/_fmt_title in routes/action_items.py. Realistic rating now correctly uses MPPS projected_percentage (since MyDezider factors have only `rating`, not std_rating). Delta is computed projected-original when delta_percentage is null. Square brackets formatting matches the spec exactly.
